page.layout: One printed page (right of the binding); running head with page number at top; body text in one column with mathematical displays and diagrams; a narrow strip of text at the left edge belongs to the facing left page and is not transcribed as part of this page's text (only the fragments visible at the gutter are left out).

main_text.p: eundum temporis proportionem instituì oportere, uia deo. Ad eam conficiendam, dantur posterioris rationis consequentes additi, scilicet 60, antecedentes autem non separati solùm, sed etiam duplices, ut hîc uides:

Duplices igitur terminos multiplicatione primùmconpono, sic inæqualia tempora in æqualia quodâmodo reduco, facli erunt 100 & 75, qui idem uolùt, ac si dicas, priorem 100 aureis uno anno idem lucrum reportaturum, quod 50 aureis biennio reportaret. Item, posteriorem 75 aureis fortis uno anno tantum acquisituram, quantum quinquennio 15 aureis acquirere posset. Porrò hi facli 100 & 75 separatim positi, tertium proportionis locum: additi inter se, nempe 175, primum complebunt: optatos uerò, Aurea regula bis repetita expediet, hoc modo:
Demonstrationem huius compositionis, cùm superiori non sit dissimilis, consultò prætermitto.
main_text.head: Aliud.
main_text.p: 2. Pedites 160, & 40 equites prædam 138 aureorum communiter diuidendam

page.notes: Mathematical display with fractions and ratio columns reproduced as lines; the fraction 2/7 and 5/7 are set as stacked numerals. Gutter fragments on the left edge (&, ul, ti-, ter, etc.) belong to the facing page and are omitted. Some numerals in the displays are uncertain.
